episode_row: 3am pull/build/preview chain failed; blend 2–3 days stale

commits.subject: fix(cron): add --start/--end to bts data pull in 3am chain
commits.body:
The bts CLI was updated to require --start and --end date arguments on
`bts data pull`. The cron's existing invocation had no args, so every
nightly 3am run was short-circuiting at the first command in the chain
with "Error: Missing option '--start'." — which meant `bts data build`
and `bts preview` never ran, and no new blend pickle was generated.

The downstream effect: production was running with a blend trained 2-3
days stale relative to the latest compute.py, creating a feature drift
that nobody noticed until I probed the 3am retrain watcher tonight.

Fix: pass a 7-day backfill window to `bts data pull`. 7 days catches any
late MLB scoring corrections without re-downloading the full season each
night. Dates are computed at cron-execution time via `$(date -d ...)` so
the window slides naturally.
